subject: maths
question: Two sections A and B of class VIII consist of 42 and 38 students, respectively. If the average marks of section A is 400 and that of section B is 320, find the average marks of the whole class.
solution:
**Given:**

Number of students in section A = 42

Number of students in section B = 38

Average marks of section A = 400

Average marks of section B = 320

**Formula used:**

Average marks of the whole class = dfrac{{Total marks of section A + Total marks of section B}}{{Total number of students}}
